derivation: Classified from the static Alpaca condition metadata (sources) and documented consolidated last-sale semantics. Never from outcomes, prices or trade frequencies.
combinationRule: any exclude code -> print ignored; else an unknown tape, an empty condition list, or any censor or unlisted code -> print uncertain; else counts. An uncertain print censors the outcome only if it reaches the target before any counted print does.

.why: Regular Sale: ordinary execution at the market.

4.why: Derivatively Priced: price derived from another instrument or benchmark, not set by the market at that instant.

5.why: Market Center Reopening Trade: a real auction execution. It can only print when trading resumes, and evaluation stops at the start of any interruption, so it never counts inside an interrupted horizon.

6.why: Market Center Closing Trade: a real auction execution. Unreachable in primary scope (horizon ends before the close).

7.why: Qualified Contingent Trade: priced by a linked instrument, exempt from trade-through.

9.meaning: Corrected Consolidated Close Price as per Listing Market
9.why: Corrected Consolidated Close: a correction of a summary price, not an execution.

B.why: Average Price Trade (CTA meaning): not a single execution price.

C.why: Cash Trade (same-day clearing): special settlement, not a regular-way market price.

F.why: Inter-market Sweep Order: ordinary execution routed as an ISO.

H.why: Price Variation Trade: price outside the prevailing market by definition.

I.why: Odd Lot Trade: does not update the consolidated last sale. A single sub-100-share print must not be able to manufacture a +2% hit. DECISION ITEM.

K.meaning: Rule 127 (NYSE only) or Rule 155 (NYSE MKT only)
K.why: Rule 127 / Rule 155: NYSE/AMEX block executions that update the last sale.

L.why: Sold Last (late reporting): the timestamp is the report time, not when the price was available. Excluded conservatively. DECISION ITEM.

M.why: Market Center Official Close: a summary price, not an execution.

O.why: Market Center Opening Trade: a real auction execution.

P.why: Prior Reference Price: priced at an earlier market.

Q.why: Market Center Official Open: a summary price, not an execution.

T.why: Extended Hours Trade (Form T): outside regular hours.

V.why: Contingent Trade: priced by a linked instrument.

X.why: Cross Trade: an exchange cross at the market.

Z.why: Sold (out of sequence): the timestamp does not reflect when the price was available.

openQuestions: Regular sale on CTA tapes appears in the metadata as " " (space). The docs example shows "@" on tape C only. If Alpaca delivers CTA regular sales as "@", every CTA hit would be uncertain and censored until "@" is added to tapes A/B.
Odd lots (I), Sold Last (L) and Stopped Stock (1) are excluded conservatively.
